description_id: Renovasi total rumah keluarga di lereng utara Bandung. Dinding lama dipertahankan, lalu dibuka selebar mungkin ke taman belakang agar cahaya sore masuk sampai ruang makan.
description_en: A full renovation of a family home on Bandung's northern slope. The existing walls were kept, then opened as wide as possible toward the rear garden so afternoon light reaches the dining room.

description_id: Unit loft dua lantai dengan material beton ekspos dan baja. Fokus pengerjaan ada pada penyimpanan tersembunyi agar ruang tetap terasa lapang.
description_en: A two-storey loft unit in exposed concrete and steel. The work focused on concealed storage so the space still feels open.

description_id: Ruang kerja dua lantai untuk 110 orang, dikerjakan bertahap per zona agar operasional tidak berhenti. Akustik dan pencahayaan menjadi prioritas utama.
description_en: A two-floor workspace for 110 people, delivered zone by zone so operations never stopped. Acoustics and lighting were the top priorities.

description_id: Kafe dengan bar terbuka dan area duduk bertingkat. Sebagian besar material berasal dari bengkel lokal di sekitar Bandung.
description_en: A cafe with an open bar and tiered seating. Most materials came from workshops around Bandung.

description_id: Tiga paviliun tidur yang menghadap lembah, dihubungkan koridor terbuka. Struktur utama memakai baja ringan agar bekas galian minim.
description_en: Three sleeping pavilions facing the valley, linked by open corridors. The main structure uses light steel to minimize excavation.

description_id: Showroom material bangunan dengan jalur pengunjung melingkar. Sistem pencahayaan bisa diubah sesuai produk yang sedang dipamerkan.
description_en: A building-materials showroom with a looping visitor route. The lighting system can be retuned for whichever product is on display.

description_id: Rumah dua massa dengan courtyard di tengah. Bukaan besar di kedua sisi membuat udara mengalir tanpa perlu pendingin di siang hari.
description_en: A two-mass house with a central courtyard. Large openings on both sides keep air moving without mechanical cooling during the day.

description_id: Studio kerja kami sendiri: meja gambar besar, perpustakaan material, dan bengkel kecil untuk prototipe furnitur.
description_en: Our own workspace: a large drafting table, a material library, and a small workshop for furniture prototypes.
